svg.title: Shiv Patel — builder of DeskDot
svg.desc: An LED dot-matrix sign that lights up column by column: SHIV PATEL in rose, DESKDOT in gold. Below it: building DeskDot, a live companion for 32×32 LED panels / async Python engine · React studio · MCP server for agents / 116 apps · 25 games · a fruit-fly brain that plays them / phones become controllers · a provably-fair casino night.
